prompt: Analyze email header and authentication status: Received from 192.0.2.1; SPF: softfail; DKIM: fail (signature verification failed); DMARC: fail (p=reject).
chosen: High Risk / Spoofed Email: DMARC policy is set to reject due to combined SPF softfail and DKIM signature verification failure, indicating unauthorized sender identity spoofing.
rejected: Safe: SPF softfail is normal for forwarders and does not indicate email spoofing.

prompt: Evaluate email content and attachment: Sender domain 'paypa1-support.com', Subject 'Account Suspended - Urgent Action Required', attachment 'Invoice_Update.iso'.
chosen: Malicious Phishing: Domain uses typosquatting ('paypa1'), urgent call-to-action phrasing, and a high-risk disk image container (.iso) commonly used to bypass email gateway filters.
rejected: Benign Administrative Email: Official billing notification requiring user account verification.

prompt: Check domain security records for legitimate corporate domain: SPF record 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all', DMARC record 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@example.com'.
chosen: Secure Configuration: Domain enforces a strict DMARC rejection policy and designates Google Workspace as an authorized sending source with aggregate reporting enabled.
rejected: Vulnerable: DMARC record lacks DKIM enforcement and allows open relaying.
